Sum of unpaid_amount matches dashboard balance (agathe balance = 1751.85 EUR debiteur, but only 3 appels displayed in UI - the remaining balance is the accumulated debt from all three unpaid calls). BUT Compte epargne BE14XXXXXXXX1383 still shows 0,00 EUR - expected 13 111,41 EUR. The real JE account is 55011383 (last4=1383 matches IBAN.last4), which the current code cannot discover. critical.issue: iter93cl fix incomplete: when a bank account has NO bank_statements imported, the code falls back to broken pcmn config (copro.bank_accounts.pcmn_number=55038300, 0 JE lines) instead of discovering the real PCMN (55011383) via IBAN.last4 vs journal_entries.lines.account_number. Result: Compte epargne Agathe shows balance 0.00 EUR instead of 13111.41 EUR. Reproduction: GET /api/owner/bank-accounts/c9cfce94-96c6-4202-8a6d-0a5627b50856 - check bank_accounts[0] with iban ending 1383, balance is 0.0. Verified in DB: JE aggregation on lines.account_number=55011383 = 13111.41 EUR. Fix suggestion: after failing to find match in bank_statements, add a second pass that scans distinct journal_entries.lines.account_number (regex ^55|^54) for values whose last4 == iban.last4.
